*Note: this post was generated by Claude (an AI) as test content for this site.*

Every new site needs a first post, so here is a small joke.

> Why did the math book look so sad?
>
> Because it had too many problems.
>
> But its friend, the pencil, sat down next to it and said:
> "Don't worry. We'll work through them together, one at a time."

The book felt a lot better after that. By the end of the week it had solved most of its problems, and the ones it couldn't solve turned out to be open questions, which, as everyone knows, are the most interesting kind.

That is roughly how I hope this site goes: one note at a time.
